detail.detail: blocked: manufacturer mode publishes no price, and the ACP feed requires one on every item. docs/truesync/truesync-protocol-specs.md §1 (acp-feed-stable-2026-08-18): "Required for non-Ads feeds: `item_id`, `title`, `description`, `url`, `brand`, `image_url`, `price` ("79.99 USD"), `availability` (...), `target_countries`, `seller_name`, and OpenAI flags `is_eligible_search`, `is_eligible_checkout`."
